entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: One of the five elder dragons of Tarkir, a hungry antlered predator breathing green flame; dragonlord of the Temur.

entities.name: Atarka's brood
entities.description: Dragons and followers of Atarka, who must feed the dragons first.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Spirit dragon whose tempests produced the broods.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Planeswalker who created the current timeline.

entities.name: Yasova
entities.description: Temur leader who fed Atarka mammoth carcasses.

entities.name: Tae Jin
entities.description: Member of Yasova's band whose vision of Nicol Bolas impressed Atarka.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon planeswalker seen in Tae Jin's vision.

entities.name: Arel
entities.description: Young shaman of the Atarka who had visions of a Tarkir without dragonlords.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Former planeswalker who used the Stormnexus Ritual.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: Ritual that raised five spirit dragons and defeated the dragonlords.

entities.name: Temur
entities.description: Clan that Atarka's brood originally ruled.

entities.name: Khanfall of Tarkir
entities.description: Fall of the khans to the dragonlords.

events.summary: Yasova feeds Atarka mammoth carcasses to distract the dragons from the Temur; the dragons later purge shamans.
events.quote: Yasova satiated her hunger by feeding her mammoth carcasses

events.summary: Eighteen years after the Khanfall Atarka confronts Yasova's hunting band; Tae Jin's vision of Bolas saves them.
events.quote: The band were only saved because Tae Jin had a vision of Nicol Bolas

events.summary: The invasion's casualties weaken the dragonlords and rebellions gain traction.
events.quote: sufficiently weakened the dragonlords' grip on power

events.summary: Narset is persuaded to use the Stormnexus Ritual.
events.quote: she uncovered a spell scroll for the Stormnexus Ritual

events.summary: Spirit dragons defeat the dragonlords, who are swallowed by the storm.
events.quote: the dragonlords were defeated and seemingly swallowed up by the massive storm

relations.quote: Led by Surrak , the Hunt Caller
Atarka and her brood emerged full-fledged from Ugin 's dragon tempests
